finding: 630 match/event records created: 629 played and 1 cancelled.
recommended_action: Preserve cancelled Cádiz return fixture as a non-played event; do not include in played-match KPIs.

finding: 14 Real Madrid CWC matches from editions 2016, 2017, 2018, 2022 and 2025 have been integrated into the master match file.
recommended_action: Retain both competition edition and football-season fields; 2022 edition was played in February 2023; 2025 edition mapped to 2024-25.

finding: Four neutral-venue UCL match-log records have no home/away assignment in the Sports Reference source.
recommended_action: Keep home_team/away_team blank for these records rather than infer; Real Madrid-perspective score remains available.

finding: Seven Copa del Rey matches are flagged as requiring extra time; supplied match logs do not consistently include the 90-minute score.
recommended_action: Retain final score and extra_time_played flag; collect regulation-time scores only if needed for detailed knockout analysis.

finding: Cádiz return fixture dated 2015-12-16 is cancelled/disqualification event with no played score.
recommended_action: Retain as Cancelled with blank score fields; exclude from played match counts.

finding: Supplied CSV had an extra quotation layer causing all fields to load as one column.
recommended_action: Parsed into structured fields in the cleaned master; original ZIP untouched.

finding: Supplied CSV had an extra quotation layer; 2016 referee and several attendance values required correction.
recommended_action: Structured records integrated; 2016 referee set to Milorad Mažić; attendances corrected to official values 17,939; 30,421; 12,424; 31,042; 56,042.
status: Resolved in master CSV; preserve correction notes

finding: Two 2017 match records in supplied CSV had blank venue and source fields.
recommended_action: Home/away teams and scores are present; stadium/source attribution remains blank in master rather than inventing provenance.

finding: 2022-23 workbook inside original ZIP is a two-match extract, not the full-season all-competitions dataset.
recommended_action: Used the separately uploaded corrected 2022-23 all-competitions export (36 player rows; 27 with appearances).

finding: No verified stable player IDs are present in the supplied player tables.
recommended_action: A name-based candidate key is included for provisional joins; do not treat it as a verified unique player ID.

finding: No comprehensive player-by-match performance dataset was found.
recommended_action: Player_Match_Stats.csv is schema-only; separate source collection required for match-level analysis.

finding: Season player workbooks are all-competition aggregates; separate La Liga and Champions League player splits are not present in the supplied archives.
recommended_action: Copa del Rey and CWC competition-level aggregates are included in supplementary Player_Competition_Stats.csv.

finding: Transfermarkt export supplied and integrated: 214 Real Madrid transaction rows across 2015-16 to 2025-26 (82 arrivals, 132 departures).
recommended_action: Preserve missing exact dates and fee uncertainty; validate high-value/relevant transfers against transaction-level sources before publishing.
status: Resolved — populated master transfer CSV; transaction-level verification remains open

finding: Financial reporting basis changes: supplied reports are standalone club basis through 2020-21 and consolidated group basis from 2021-22.
recommended_action: Scope field is recorded per row; use caution in longitudinal comparisons and explain the break in reporting perimeter.

finding: 2025-26 budget and official results summary are supplied; full annual financial statements/auditor report are not in the current file set.
recommended_action: Keep actual announcement facts distinct from audited statements; add full accounts after official publication.

finding: Budget PDF page 2 reports total operating expenses before D&A of €1,025.562m; page 4 segment table sums to €1,025.561m.
recommended_action: Master financials uses page 2 consolidated total; retain €0.001m discrepancy note.

finding: Official announcement table reports EBITDA before disposals €243.0m while prose states €242.9m.
recommended_action: Master financials retains table value €243.0m and documents prose rounding discrepancy.

finding: 2015-16 P&L facts are taken from comparative column in 2016-17 annual financial statements.
recommended_action: 2015-16 management report and budget settlement remain in source inventory; confirm any baseline-only figures against those documents.

finding: Sponsorship and merchandising are not consistently disclosed as separate numerical revenue lines across the full period; marketing revenue is reported as an aggregate.
recommended_action: Use marketing revenue as disclosed; do not fabricate separate sponsorship/merchandising series.

finding: 22 trophy records have been derived from final match results and calculated La Liga standings.
recommended_action: Cross-check the derived list against official Real Madrid/competition honours records before publishing trophy counts.

finding: 11 Real Madrid league-standing rows were calculated from the full 380-match season files.
recommended_action: Ranking uses points, goal difference and goals scored; verify against official final tables.

finding: Some raw data files do not retain exact source URLs, access dates or licence notes.
recommended_action: Complete URL, retrieval date, collection method and reuse conditions in Source_Register.csv.

finding: A previous audit stated four exact duplicate rows in Copa CSV files; this claim was not reproduced when the supplied raw CSVs were re-read.
recommended_action: No rows were removed on that basis. Revisit only if a specific file/row is identified.

finding: The uploaded repository ZIP contains documentation and folder structure but not the raw/cleaned datasets or generated master CSVs.
recommended_action: Copy approved master CSV outputs into the local GitHub project structure; keep raw data excluded or protected according to the existing .gitignore policy.

finding: 616 dated team-level match-log rows from 11 season workbooks were linked one-to-one to the canonical match IDs; one entirely blank separator row was excluded.
recommended_action: Use Real_Madrid_Match_Team_Stats.csv for team-level match context; retain 14 CWC matches with no Sports Reference squad match-log row as explicitly unavailable.

finding: The 14 FIFA Club World Cup match results are present in the master match file, but the supplied Sports Reference match-log workbooks contain no corresponding team match-log rows for those CWC fixtures.
recommended_action: Keep result records in the match master; leave unsupported possession/captain/formation/referee fields blank and mark match_log_available=false.

finding: The supplied Transfermarkt season overview has no exact transfer dates for all 214 rows.
recommended_action: Preserve transfer_date as missing; collect transaction-level dates only if day-level chronology is needed.

finding: 91 of 214 transfer rows have no numeric fee; the source distinguishes loans, free transfers, internal promotions, loan returns, releases and retirements.
recommended_action: Do not treat missing fees as zero. Separate loan fees from permanent transfer fees and preserve fee_status.

finding: No authoritative player IDs are embedded consistently across supplied player and transfer files.
recommended_action: Generated provisional RMPLR name-based IDs and crosswalk; validate aliases and collisions before production joins.

finding: The supplied Sports Reference md workbooks are team-level match logs, not individual player-by-match performance tables. No comprehensive player-match dataset was found in the supplied files.
recommended_action: Keep Player_Match_Stats schema-only. Do not misclassify team match logs as player-level stats.
status: Open — individual player-match data not supplied

finding: Competition-level player aggregates currently cover Copa del Rey and FIFA Club World Cup 2022/2025; a complete La Liga and Champions League player-competition split is not present in the supplied master.
recommended_action: Use season aggregates for all-competition analysis; collect competition-specific tables only if required for competition comparisons.

finding: Casemiro appears twice in 2015-16 arrival records: a loan return and a subsequent permanent transfer. These are distinct transaction events, not exact duplicate rows.
recommended_action: Retain both events and distinguish by transfer_type.

finding: Created a 630-row match team-statistics table: 616 Sports Reference team match-log records plus 14 CWC result rows marked as lacking the corresponding Sports Reference match log.
recommended_action: Use match_log_available to distinguish detailed Sports Reference team logs from CWC result-only records.
